drums.description: Hard rock instrumental featuring a prominent, syncopated drum kit and distorted electric guitar, The track opens with a rhythmic pattern of heavy floor tom hits and snare accents accompanied by the sound of falling rain and distant thunder, At 0:20, a high-gain electric guitar enters with a repetitive, palm-muted riff centered around a low E pedal tone, The drums transition into a driving 4/4 backbeat with open hi-hats and frequent crash cymbal hits, The guitar performance utilizes power chords and brief melodic fills using the E minor pentatonic scale, The production is dry with minimal reverb on the drums, while the guitar has a thick, saturated distortion, The tempo is 130 BPM in the key of E minor Publish

bass.description: Hard rock instrumental featuring a prominent, overdriven electric bass guitar as the lead melodic and rhythmic voice, The track is built around a repetitive, syncopated four-bar riff in E minor at 115 BPM, The bass tone is characterized by heavy saturation and a mid-range growl, utilizing aggressive fingerstyle plucking, A standard drum kit maintains a steady backbeat with a dry, punchy snare and a consistent eighth-note hi-hat pattern, The arrangement follows a minimalist structure, focusing on the interplay between the distorted bass ostinato and the driving percussion, with occasional variations in the bass line's rhythmic density Publish
